irregularities.title: Root cause of DrivenData portal error 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'
irregularities.finding: DrivenData's submission validator checks finite [0, 1] compliance across the uploaded single-band raster; GeoTIFFs encoding the 7,111,787 outside-footprint cells as IEEE-754 NaN (`-nan.tif`, e.g. `gems24-h25-1-dotted-h19-5-d1-5-20261002-989f59505db1-nan.tif` or `gems30-MSDB1-...tif`) or `-9999.0` float32 sentinels trigger `Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]` whenever NaN/nodata handling differs.
irregularities.resolution: Shipped exclusively `-zeros.tif` (`nodata=None`, all 12,279,160 pixels finite float32 in `{0.0, 1.0}`, 0 NaN inside or outside footprint, 0 Inf, 0 negative values), verified programmatically by 13/13 checks in `submission.py` and `tests/test_lwst_submission.py`.

irregularities.title: Cross-site duplication across all 9 focus sites' Era-1 leaderboard winners (H19-5 / D2.8 family)
irregularities.finding: Every Era-1 live-scored winner across GEMSDOE24..36 (`0.2449` to `0.2778`) has 86.7%–100.0% within-3px dot overlap with the GEMSDOE32 0.2778 Champion (`e5eb6e7e-zeros.tif`). Moreover, GEMSDOE25 and GEMSDOE30 (`e56ea318af89-zeros.tif`, 0.2600) are byte-identical (`XOR = 0`), and GEMSDOE28 `h27-4` and GEMSDOE31 `h27-4` (`8acb75e1`, 0.2708) have `XOR = 0` positive pixels.
irregularities.resolution: All Era-1 files are marked DO NOT RESUBMIT in the Executive Summary table; GEMSDOESASS3 achieves 41.53% overlap vs the 0.2778 Champion and <= 63.27% across all 385 genuine rasters.

irregularities.title: Legacy GitHub Pages URL in prompt (`buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/GEMSDOE32/docs/index.html`)
irregularities.finding: The URL in the prompt uses a legacy owner (`buffedlizard55-lab`) and redundant `/docs/` prefix (GitHub Pages mounts `/docs` at `/GEMSDOE32/`).
irregularities.resolution: Active verified repository and Pages root are `https://github.com/sassnarep3-star/GEMSDOE32` and `https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/GEMSDOE32/`.

irregularities.title: Synthetic 206,895-dot 5x5 px calibration lattice (`13gems_20261001_r13-lattice-s5_v2_nan-outside.tif`) in historical archive
irregularities.finding: Because max Euclidean distance on a 5x5 px grid is sqrt(2^2 + 2^2) = 2.828 <= 3.0 px, its 3-px buffer covers 99.871% of the entire 5,167,373-pixel footprint, causing any footprint-spanning map (including random noise and the 0.2778 Champion) to register ~99.8% raw 3-px proximity despite Spearman ~ 0.00.
irregularities.resolution: `registry_audit.py` separates synthetic space-filling calibration probes (`coverage >= 70%`) via null-calibrated excess (`passed = True`), AND GEMSDOESASS3 literally passes `< 70%` 3-px overlap (`max = 63.27%`) and `|Spearman| <= 0.90` (`max = 0.1255`) against 100% of all 378 valid rasters in the 9 focus sites and all 385 genuine rasters.

irregularities.title: Era-2 scarp-only ML off-catalogue regression in GEMSDOE36 (`KPL-36`) and GEMSDOE28 (`S22-CTXHGB`)
irregularities.finding: Both Oct 26 sibling candidates achieved high quaternary OOF (`0.1407` with non-standard 8-px collar in GEMSDOE36; `0.1449` in GEMSDOE28) by concentrating dots near visible fault tips or smooth regional elevation bands, causing off-catalogue `GEMSDOE32-SGMC-CAL-v3.0` to drop to `0.0445` (-30.7%) and `0.0505` (-21.2%) vs the 0.2778 Champion (`0.0641`).
irregularities.resolution: GEMSDOESASS3 enforces a Dual-Evaluator promotion gate requiring simultaneous improvement over the 0.2778 Champion on BOTH `HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0` (`0.111062 > 0.099202`, paired 95% CI `[+0.0035, +0.0207]`) AND `SGMC-CAL-v3.0` (`0.065702 > 0.064121`).

irregularities.title: Laplacian sign convention (`curv_s1 > 0` in V-shaped stream thalwegs) & hard PU negative screening leak
irregularities.finding: `ndimage.gaussian_laplace(dem)` is positive in concave-up drainage stream thalwegs rather than convex scarp breaks; additionally, deleting `unsup >= q97` only from `y = 0` while keeping `unsup` as a tree feature induces P(y=1 | unsup >= q97) = 1.0 in tree leaves.
irregularities.resolution: Added explicit V-shaped thalweg (`curv_s1 > 0`) and ridge-summit (`tophat >> 0`) vetoes on rectilinear planar scarps (lifting `EXP1` zero-supervision `SGMC-CAL` from `0.0480` to `0.0752`) and replaced hard `q97` negative deletion with clean 5-px collar Dual-Objective (Binary + 300 m Kernel Regressor) HGB training (lifting `EXP2` `HIDE-RECOVER` from `0.0860` to `0.1167`).

irregularities.title: Leaderboard progression (`0.4413` -> `0.4544`) and sandbox outbound firewall allowlist
irregularities.finding: Live DrivenData public leaderboard fetched on 2026-10-27 shows `#1 = 0.4544` (`xiaofanhu`), advancing from the prompt's `0.4413` snapshot. Outbound sandbox access permits GitHub/PyPI/npm (excluding `earthquake.usgs.gov` FDSN API needed for Rank-4 hypothesis `H-SASS3-D`).
irregularities.resolution: Both the prompt's `0.4413` baseline and live `2026-10-27` `0.4544` leaderboard top score are cited transparently with official links; `H-SASS3-D` is documented as a verified future roadmap item without fabrication.
